_doc: #557: title patterns of papers that are THE core papers of a published theme. They are exempt from the BFS off-topic citation ceiling (seed max cites x 2, seedFilters.ts filterOffTopicRefs): when OpenAlex's citation counts rise, these would otherwise fall out of a rebuild (Mamba did on 2026-11-22). Only the ceiling is skipped; the denylist, the topic gate and every other filter still apply, and no edge is forced (unlike lineage_foundational_allowlist.json). Add a pattern only for a paper that is central to a published theme.
